name: Bundle-Adjusted Neural Radiance Field (BARF)
definition: Jointly estimates poses alongside the training of the neural radiance field using coarse-to-fine registration by adaptively masking the positional encoding.
summary: BARF jointly optimizes camera poses and NeRF parameters from uncalibrated images using a coarse-to-fine frequency annealing schedule to stabilize optimization without external Structure-from-Motion preprocessing.
